utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll keep it brief and task-focused. I’ll send a simple list of donation needs and repair priorities.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — send the list when you’re ready, and I’ll keep track of the locations and organize the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — thanks, Vik. Let me know what comes up, and I’ll help keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here now — what’s the next thing you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — Gus has tools covered, so if you can send me the locations, I’ll pass them to Opal for organizing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I can check what we’ve got left and make a quick needs list. Just tell me what’s most needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo—could you list the biggest gaps first, especially tools, volunteers, and any supplies we still need? I’ll help sort what to tackle next.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still rolling — I’m hearing folks are gathering donations and sorting the biggest fixes first. What time this weekend works best for you around school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning sounds good — I can work around school pickup then.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—let’s lock in a clear time for the repair drive, and I’ll send the details around so it’s easy for everyone to join.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I can help get the tools and supplies ready once you pick the time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: After school still seems best to me—say around 3:30 or later, once pickup traffic eases. Let me know what time window works for you.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: 3:30 or later works for me — I can help after school and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard folks are still gathering donations and sorting the repair priorities, so a quick list would really help. I can pass along any updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be a big help, Nell—could you bring me any donation updates and a quick rundown of the top repair priorities? I’ll turn it into a simple list for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, sounds good — just send me the time and I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll send the time soon. Are you able to help with supplies too, if needed?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Kira—our repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, so let’s spread that update first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm, it’s still happening Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll check what we still need and keep it practical.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, that works — send me the list when you have it and I’ll keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little with the repair drive, but I’d like to keep it low-key for now. If there’s a small task that fits around the weekend, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—let’s pick one small task and set a clear time this weekend.
